title: The Mystery Call
narration: A whale sings at 52 hertz. Blue whales? 10 to 40. Fin whales? 20 to 30. This one? Alone at 52.
visual_goal: A lone whale silhouette in deep blue ocean, sound wave pulsing at 52Hz in red against the backdrop. Quick cut to hydrophone array underwater.

title: First Detection
narration: Detected in 1989 by the U.S. Navy’s SOSUS array. No one knew what it was.
visual_goal: Black-and-white sonar screen flickering to life, 1989 timestamp. Close-up of hydrophone in murky water.

title: The Loneliness Factor
narration: Every year since—no answers. No sightings. Just this call, louder than the ocean’s noise.
visual_goal: Time-lapse of hydrophone networks lighting up across the Pacific. Whale call waveform spikes above ambient noise.
search_queries: whale call louder than ocean noise

title: Where Is It?
narration: From California to the Aleutians—30,000 miles tracked. But no one’s seen it.
visual_goal: Animated map of the North Pacific with a pulsing red dot moving erratically. Satellite imagery of ocean swells.

title: The Clue
narration: Acoustic analysis says it’s a blue whale. But blue whales don’t sing at 52.
visual_goal: Side-by-side spectrograms: a standard blue whale call (10-40Hz) vs. the 52Hz spike. Scientist’s finger pointing at the mismatch.

title: Why 52?
narration: 30 decibels louder than the ocean’s hum. A voice screaming into the void.
visual_goal: Underwater microphone close-up, sound waves radiating outward. Whale silhouette with sound waves distorting the water.

title: The Pattern
narration: December and January—peak calls. August, a whisper. Then silence.
visual_goal: Calendar with red dots marking December/January, a smaller dot in August. Hydrophone blinking off-screen.

title: The Art
narration: Books. Albums. Even a 2015 album titled ‘52 Hz I Love You.’ A voice turned into art.
visual_goal: Collage of book covers, album art, and paintings featuring the 52Hz whale. Vinyl record spinning with the title visible.
search_queries: 52 Hz I Love You album cover

title: The Question
narration: Is it lost? Or is it the only one of its kind?
visual_goal: Whale silhouette fading into deep blue. Hydrophone array in the distance, lights flickering.

title: The Call Continues
narration: 52 hertz. Every year. Waiting for an answer.
visual_goal: Whale call waveform looping endlessly. Fade to black with the number 52Hz glowing in the darkness.
